'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Insurgency in the Maghreb]]
**Gunmen [[mass shooting|open fire]] at a [[Military base|military post]] near a [[Gold mining|gold mine]] in Inata, [[Soum Province]], [[Burkina Faso]], killing 19 [[Gendarmerie|gendarmes]] and a civilian. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/11/14/attack-on-burkina-faso-defence-outpost-kills-at-least-20 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Liverpool Women's Hospital bombing]]
**A passenger is killed and his driver injured when a taxi explodes in front of the [[Liverpool Women's Hospital]] in [[Liverpool]], [[England]]. Three men are subsequently arrested under the [[Terrorism Acts|Terrorism Act]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-59285235 (BBC News)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**A bomb explodes near a vehicle carrying troops in [[Deir ez-Zor]], [[Syria]], killing four soldiers and a general. [https://english.alaraby.co.uk/news/five-soldiers-killed-syria-attack-monitor (''The New Arab'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]; [[Capital punishment in Somalia]]
**Two [[Ugandan soldier]]s are [[Capital punishment|sentenced to death]] and three more receive 39-year prison [[sentence (law)|sentences]] in [[Somalia]] for killing seven civilians during a gun battle in Golweyn, [[Lower Shabelle]], three months ago. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-59280210 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Astroworld Festival crowd crush]]
**A 9-year-old boy, injured during a [[crowd crush]] at the [[Astroworld Festival|Astroworld Music Festival]], who had been in a medically-induced [[coma]], dies, bringing the death toll to 10. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/11/14/us/astroworld-festival-child-death/index.html (CNN)]
*[[European migrant crisis]]
**Eight [[sub-Saharan Africa]]n migrants are found dead on a boat adrift off the southern coast of the [[Canary Islands]], with 54 other men being rescued from the boat. [https://elpais.com/espana/2021-11-14/hallados-ocho-inmigrantes-muertos-en-una-patera-a-la-deriva-al-sur-de-gran-canaria.html (''El País'')]
*A fire at a [[COVID-19]] ward in [[Sliven]], [[Bulgaria]], kills three patients. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/fire-covid-hospital-kills-bulgaria-81161684 (ABC News)]
*A magnitude 6.5 [[list of earthquakes in Iran|earthquake]] strikes [[Hormozgan Province]], [[Iran]], at a depth of {{convert|10|km|mi}} and is felt in many southern Iranian cities. A man killed by a falling pole is the sole death reported. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/earthquake-magnitude-65-strikes-southern-iran-emsc-2021-11-14/ (Reuters)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
***[[Chancellor of Austria|Chancellor]] [[Alexander Schallenberg]] announces a nationwide [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] for those over the age of 12 years who are [[COVID-19 vaccination in Austria|unvaccinated]] against COVID-19, which prohibits them from leaving their homes except for essential reasons beginning at midnight, amid a record increase in new COVID-19 cases. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-europe-austria-health-d00bebed71fbf5b69a19a549ef7279b9 (AP)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Egypt]]
***The [[Egypt]]ian [[Government of Egypt|government]] announces the start of clinical trials for COVI-VAX, which is the country’s first domestically-made [[COVID-19 vaccine]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContentP/1/439642/Egypt/Clinical-trials-for-COVIVAX-coronavirus-vaccine-ki.aspx (Ahram Online)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Israel]]
***The [[Israel]]i [[Ministry of Health (Israel)|Health ministry]] approves the usage of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] for children aged 5 to 11, two weeks after the U.S. [[FDA]] grants its own approval, with vaccination expected to begin next week. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-s-health-ministry-approves-covid-vaccine-for-younger-children-1.10383066 (''Haaretz'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Peru]]
***[[Peru]] announces that people over the age of 18 years who want to enter indoor spaces must show a proof of [[COVID-19 vaccination in Peru|full vaccination]] against COVID-19 beginning in December, either physical or virtual [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|vaccination card]]s. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/peru-to-require-covid-vaccine-proof-for-indoor-spaces-next-month-01636926008?refsec=afp-news (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Bulgarian general election]]
**[[Bulgarians]] go to the polls to elect the [[President of Bulgaria|President]] and the [[National Assembly of Bulgaria|National Assembly]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/bulgarians-vote-in-third-election-this-year-in-bid-to-break-deadlock/ar-AAQFRe6?ocid=BingNewsSearch (MSN)]
*[[2021 Argentine legislative election]]
**[[Argentines]] go to the polls to elect members of the [[Chamber of Deputies of Argentina|Chamber of Deputies]] and the [[Senate of Argentina|Senate]]. [https://247newsagency.com/top-news/14788.html?amp (24/7 News Agency)]
